concerns.location: plan.md:Summary — 'Scope inconsistency' paragraph; research.md §2 'blocking finding'
concerns.text: The plan's own gating design concedes the central hypothesis (motif z-scores associate with rsFC metrics) cannot be tested: no verified structural connectome source exists, so T007's partial correlations will never run on real data. A plan whose primary analysis is expected to be skipped does not answer the research question. The plan correctly refuses fabrication, but proceeding to implementation before the spec names a verified paired diffusion+rs-fMRI dataset (or reframes the question, e.g. functional-graph motifs vs. functional metrics) means the deliverable cannot satisfy FR-005/FR-006/SC-003 by construction.

concerns.location: research.md §3.3 / plan.md FR-005 traceability — 'controlling for structural global degree'
concerns.text: The partial-correlation control variable 'structural global degree' is derived from the structural connectome. In the gated scenario this covariate is undefined, yet T007 is traced to FR-005 unconditionally. Specify what happens to the 'partial' aspect (and to VIF over motif predictors) when structural data is absent — currently the statistical design silently loses its control variable.

concerns.location: spec.md FR-005 / plan.md T007 — 'Bonferroni correction for the 13 motifs tested'
concerns.text: Undirected 3-node graphs have 4 non-isomorphic classes and 4-node graphs have 11, totaling 15, not 13. The Bonferroni denominator (α=0.05/13) and SC-003's 'all 13 motifs' are therefore based on an unexplained motif count. Either justify the 13 (e.g. excluding 2 classes) or correct the family size — this changes the adjusted α and the power analysis.

concerns.location: research.md §3.1 step 3 — 'global efficiency computed on the thresholded (|r| > 0.2) weighted graph via networkx.global_efficiency on the binarized thresholded graph'
concerns.text: Construct validity: global efficiency of a binarized |r|>0.2 functional graph is a threshold-dependent, arbitrary operationalization of 'rsFC global efficiency'; the threshold choice is unjustified and no sensitivity analysis over thresholds is planned. Also 'rsFC strength = mean absolute off-diagonal correlation' conflates positive and negative correlations — state why absolute value is the intended construct.

concerns.location: research.md §2 / plan.md T002 — 'select up to 50 subjects' from the fsLR-64k test shard
concerns.text: The verified URL points at a single test-split parquet shard; the plan provides no evidence this shard contains ≥50 distinct subjects with usable resting-state runs, nor how subjects are identified/selected across the 16 shards. If N < 50, the FR-010 power analysis (N=50) and SC-001 (95% of 50) are unachievable. Specify subject selection and a fallback if the shard yields fewer subjects.

concerns.location: research.md §3.3 — 'Partial Pearson and Spearman correlations ... controlling for structural global degree'
concerns.text: The exact partial-Spearman procedure is unstated (rank-transform then partial Pearson? residualize ranks?). Different choices yield different p-values; name the method so it is reproducible and testable.

concerns.location: plan.md Technical Context / research.md §3.1 step 2 — 'Schaefer-100 mapping applied to fsLR vertices'
concerns.text: No dependency or mechanism is planned for obtaining/mapping the Schaefer atlas to fsLR-64k vertices (no nilearn/nibabel, no atlas file source). Without the vertex→parcel lookup the parcellation step is unspecified; state where the mapping comes from and how it is verified.

concerns.location: spec.md:FR-001, FR-002, SC-001 vs plan.md Summary 'Scope inconsistency'
concerns.text: FR-001/FR-002/SC-001 require downloading diffusion tractography and constructing structural connectomes for ≥95% of 50 subjects. The plan gates the entire structural half ('if no real structural connectomes are downloadable... skips motif–rsFC association testing'), so FR-001, FR-002, and SC-001 have NO satisfiable plan element. The plan correctly surfaces this, but the root cause is the spec's Data Access section naming unverified ds001734. Spec must be corrected (name a verified open diffusion source or reframe the question) before the plan can cover these FRs.

concerns.location: spec.md:Assumptions 'sensitivity analysis will sweep |z| ∈ {1.5, 2.0, 2.5}'
concerns.text: The spec's Assumptions section commits to a motif-z sensitivity analysis sweeping |z| ∈ {1.5, 2.0, 2.5} and reporting how the number of significant motifs varies. No plan task, contract field, or report section covers this. Either add a plan element (e.g., extend T007/T008) or remove it from the spec.

concerns.location: spec.md:US-3 Acceptance 2 vs plan.md T007
concerns.text: US-3 acceptance 2 requires the permutation empirical p to be 'consistent with the analytical correction within 2× the standard error of the mean for the permutation distribution'. T007 computes empirical p but no plan element defines or checks this consistency criterion. Add a validation step or drop the acceptance clause at spec level.

concerns.location: contracts/analysis_results.schema.yaml, contracts/results.schema.yaml
concerns.text: These two contract files are not referenced by any task (T011 validates only manifest, motif profiles, correlation results, metadata) and duplicate/contradict output.schema.yaml (e.g., 'VIF for the control variable', method_used enum with ridge_regression, motif_triangle_z etc.). Plan elements with no backing FR — drop them or reconcile with output.schema.yaml.

concerns.location: plan.md:Summary — 'Scope inconsistency' block; research.md:§2 Dataset Strategy
concerns.text: The only verified dataset (clane9/openneuro-fslr64k parquet) is functional-only; the research question, FR-002/FR-004/FR-005, and SC-003 all require paired diffusion-derived structural connectomes, which no verified open source provides. As planned, the pipeline's gating means the central motif–rsFC association can never execute — the plan is data-infeasible for its own hypothesis. The plan correctly refuses fabrication and surfaces the mismatch, but planning should not proceed on a dataset strategy that deterministically cannot answer the question: either identify and verify an open structural-connectome source (e.g., an OpenNeuro dataset with preprocessed DWI tractography or published connectome matrices) or kick back to spec to reframe the question around functional-only motifs (e.g., motifs of thresholded rsFC graphs).

concerns.location: plan.md:Project Structure / contracts/
concerns.text: Plan's structure lists only 4 contracts (dataset, motif_profile, output, structural_connectome), but the contracts/ directory also contains analysis_results.schema.yaml and results.schema.yaml. Neither is referenced by any plan task (T001–T017) or the data-model's file-format list, so they are orphaned — no plan element exercises them, violating plan↔contracts coverage. Either delete them or add a task/contract-test mapping.

concerns.location: contracts/results.schema.yaml:subject_metrics
concerns.text: results.schema.yaml hard-codes exactly four motif fields (motif_triangle_z, motif_path_z, motif_edge_z, motif_isolated_z) and a network_density field, contradicting the plan/data-model's 13-motif (3- and 4-node) framing and subject_metrics.csv columns (subject_id, rsfc_strength, global_efficiency, global_degree). This contract cannot validate the planned outputs.

concerns.location: contracts/analysis_results.schema.yaml:method_used
concerns.text: analysis_results.schema.yaml requires method_used with enum {multivariate_regression, ridge_regression, permutation_only} and a per-record vif for 'the control variable', but the plan (T007) and output.schema.yaml describe VIF over the full motif predictor set with no ridge/multivariate method selection step. The two results contracts disagree with each other and with the plan.

concerns.location: plan.md:FR/SC Traceability SC-001
concerns.text: Traceability maps SC-001 ('≥95% of subjects have BOTH structural and rsFC files') to T002's cohort_actual check, yet the plan's own gating design means structural.npy will not exist for any subject when no verified diffusion source is available. The mapping presents SC-001 as satisfied while the plan's stated behavior cannot satisfy it; the surfaced spec mismatch should also be reflected here (e.g. mark SC-001 as blocked/gated) rather than checked as ✅-equivalent.

concerns.location: plan.md:Task List
concerns.text: Task IDs jump from T011 to T017 with no T012–T016; either renumber or note the gap to avoid downstream traceability confusion.

concerns.location: plan.md:Summary (Scope inconsistency) + research.md:§2 Dataset–variable fit assessment
concerns.text: The plan's own analysis establishes that the core predictor — structural connectomes — cannot be obtained from any verified source, so the central hypothesis (motif z-scores associate with rsFC metrics) is UNTESTABLE as planned. The gated pipeline can only ever return 'structural half could not be answered', i.e. a guaranteed null-by-unavailability result, not an empirical one. This is a research-question-level defect that must be resolved at spec level (verified diffusion source or reframed question) before the plan can be scientifically sound; the plan correctly surfaces it but cannot proceed to execution on an unanswerable question.

concerns.location: spec.md:FR-005 / plan.md:T007 — 'Bonferroni correction for the 13 motifs tested'
concerns.text: The motif count '13' is internally inconsistent with the enumeration scope: undirected simple graphs have 4 non-isomorphic 3-node connected motifs and 11 4-node connected motifs (15 total), or 6+11=17 if disconnected 3-node classes are included. The Bonferroni denominator (0.05/13) and SC-003 ('p-values for all 13 motifs') depend on this count; the plan should state the exact motif class list and derive the correction family from it, or the multiple-comparison correction is over/under the actual test family.

concerns.location: research.md:§3.3 — permutation test 'consistent with the analytical correction' (US-3 acceptance 2)
concerns.text: US-3 acceptance 2 requires the permutation empirical p to agree with the Bonferroni-corrected analytical p 'within 2× SEM'. This conflates two different quantities: the permutation p tests the uncorrected null (no correction applied per-shuffle), so it should agree with the RAW p-value, not the Bonferroni-corrected one. As specified, the acceptance criterion is mathematically unsatisfiable whenever raw p is small. The plan inherits this via T007/FR-006 without flagging it.

concerns.location: research.md:§3.1 step 3 — global efficiency on 'thresholded (|r| > 0.2)' rsFC graph
concerns.text: The |r|>0.2 threshold and binarization for global efficiency are stated but no justification or sensitivity analysis is planned; efficiency values depend strongly on this arbitrary threshold. A one-line rationale or threshold sweep would strengthen the outcome metric's validity. (Outcome metrics are otherwise independent of the motif predictors — no circularity there.)

new_concerns.text: Inconsistent statements: research.md claims the OpenNeuro ds001734 dataset provides paired diffusion and rs‑fMRI data, while plan.md admits no verified diffusion source exists and gates the structural half of the pipeline. This contradiction undermines the feasibility of the core analysis and must be resolved (either supply a verified diffusion source or reframe the hypothesis to functional‑only motifs).

Inconsistent dataset citations: the plan streams the verified OpenNeuro fsLR‑64k functional parquet (huggingface), while the research section claims the OpenNeuro ds001734 dataset provides both diffusion and rs‑fMRI. No verified diffusion source is actually available, and the two sections reference different datasets, creating a contradiction that prevents reproducible acquisition of the required structural connectomes.
